title: fix(console): the sidebar opens on the area that holds the current page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoJLgrzV2K6nu7KDKZeHnYTf)_

Fixes #28497

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：多 area 的应用里，Console 侧栏首次渲染、以及路由跳到当前 area 没有入口指向的页面时，切到"持有当前页面入口"的那个 area，并高亮该入口；都没有时保持原规则（当前 area，否则第一个可见 area）。
- 为什么改：深链、书签或按受众配置的 `landing` 指向第二个 area 的入口时，侧栏仍显示第一个 area 的菜单，读者看到的菜单里没有自己所在的页面。
- 风险与回滚：只动侧栏选 area 的逻辑；用户自己点选的 area 在其入口仍指向当前页面时不会被覆盖。回滚即 revert 本 PR，侧栏回到总是打开第一个 area。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/sidebarAreaElection.ts`（选举规则）、`UnifiedSidebar.tsx` 中 `electSidebarArea` 的两处调用（初始状态与路由变化 effect）、新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.areaFollowsRoute-28497.test.tsx`，预期 6 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/sidebarAreaElection.ts`: `electSidebarArea(visibleAreas, currentId, route)`. The entry the route addresses is the one `resolveActiveNavItem` (from `@object-ui/layout`) elects, the same match `NavigationRenderer` uses for the row highlight, so no second route matcher exists and the elected area always agrees with the highlighted row.
  - The current area stays while one of its entries addresses the route (card Wanted 2: a reader's own pick holds).
  - Otherwise the match runs once over every visible area's entries together, so the most specific entry wins across areas; a tie goes to the earlier area, as it does to the earlier row within one menu.
  - With no match, the current area stays, else the first visible one (today's rule).
- `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`: the `useState` initializer and the re-election effect both call `electSidebarArea`; the effect now also runs on `location.pathname` / `location.search` / `context` changes. The route is read only in the `app` context. The navigation template context (`currentUserId`, `currentOrgId`, `contextValues`) is hoisted into one `navTemplateContext` value so the election and both `NavigationRenderer` calls resolve hrefs with the same context; for that the `useAppContextSelectors` call moved above the area block (same hook, same arguments).
- Root changeset `.changeset/28497-sidebar-area-follows-route.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Tests

New `UnifiedSidebar.areaFollowsRoute-28497.test.tsx`, a real `UnifiedSidebar` with real `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/layout`, two areas (the second area's target sits inside a group):

1. Route on a second-area entry: the second area is active and its entry highlighted (`data-active="true"`), the first area's menu is not drawn.
2. Control: route on a first-area entry keeps the first area.
3. Control: no entry of any area addresses the route: the first area.
4. Route change to a page only the second area addresses: the sidebar follows.
5. Card Wanted 2: both areas hold an `account` entry; the reader picks the second area, then opens a record of that object: the pick holds.
6. A pick of an area that does not address the page holds until the route moves, then the election runs.

Ablations (through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, both restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- Election back to "keep current, else `visibleAreas[0]`" (`if (route) {` replaced by `if (false && route) {`): tests 1, 4 and 6 red, 3 passed.
- Pick-holding line deleted (`if (current && areaAddressesRoute(current, route)) return current.id;`): test 5 red, 5 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- The election reads the area's authored (readable-pruned) navigation, before the Studio-only rewrite that turns the package entry into a `url` row. Studio is one app with no `areas` today, so the difference has no reader; NOT MEASURED against a multi-area Studio, noted, not a finding.
- Visibility of single entries is not part of the match, exactly as for the highlight, which is computed over the unfiltered item list; areas themselves are only elected among visible ones.
- The `@objectstack/spec` `AppLandingEntrySchema` docblock sentence "the sidebar highlights what the reader landed on" now holds for a target in a later area; no spec edit.
- Shared files with neighbour cards: only `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` (none of the files #28477 / #28466 / #28496 declare).
